notes: Posted 5 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Jabba's Palace, Audiance Chamber, Han Solo (imprisoned per the Objective), Podrace Prep., Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Seeking An Audience; these count toward the 60. Seeking An Audience is shown as the starting effect.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Audiance Chamber' the Light Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Han Solo' the Premiere Han Solo (the starting imprisoned Han).
Posted 'Threepeo W/ Parts' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (Tatooine): the strategy says Threepeo can get rid of extra Droid Shutdowns (it places a card from hand on the Used Pile).

Posted 'Princess Leia Organa (The captive)' dested the Jabba's Palace Princess Leia Organa (deploys as an escorted captive; the strategy releases her and retrieves 5 Force from her game text), not the later virtual card.

Posted 'Rondevous Point' dested Rendezvous Point; 'Yoda's Hut' Dagobah: Yoda's Hut; 'Tatooine Troche Station.' Tatooine: Tosche Station; 'Ounee Tay' Ounee Ta (an Effect in 2001); 'OOCommission & Transmission Terminated' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Han W/ Blaster' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Leia W/ Blaster' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Luke Skywalker, Jedi Kight' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Run Luke, Run' Run Luke, Run!; 'Hopping Mad (Fetches Droid Shutdown)' the Cloud City Effect Hopping Mad; 'Strangle (destiny 7)' the Jabba's Palace interrupt Strangle.
The '6-Destiny Cards (14)' heading is a section name, not a card; its 14 cards are counted.
